content: The speaker explains that the time it takes to sort data increases with the amount of data being sorted. To analyze this, we express the time taken as a function of the input size. Importantly, we typically focus on upper bounds on the running time, because knowing the *maximum* time a program might take provides a useful guarantee to the user. Knowing only the *minimum* time is less helpful because the program could potentially run much longer.
